verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never affirmatively documents extending a clip or regenerating a single segment. The only related item (luma-docs-37) is a list of FAQ questions with no answers, so it is not affirmative support. Multi-Keyframe directs a single generation, and Modify Video is documented as applying global adherence modes with no masking, region, or segment selection, so both are adjacent features rather than the named capability.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
